reviews.title: A really great mouse!
reviews.comment: An absolute dream of a mouse if you are claw or palm grip with medium to large hands. Use zowies mouse type gemstone to find out which you are.
reviews.author: Ortiv Inga

reviews.title: Fantastic Quality
reviews.comment: Zowie is always ahead of the game with quality. My first gaming mouse was an FK1 that lasted me nearly 7 years, from which I bought on to the wireless hype and got a G Pro. I never liked the scroll wheel nor the stock feet on the logitech and it upset me considering it was more than double the price of the FK1 I previously had. Once I heard about zowies new wireless lineup i knew I had to have it. First time trying the S2 and am overall surprised at how good it feels for the size. It's slightly smaller than the G Pro so it took me a while to get used to, but the control I have over it is far superior. If I had the money I'd buy the whole lineup to try each shape!
reviews.author: J.Corral

reviews.title: Bulky.
reviews.comment: Bulky. Heavy. I had Razer Cobra wired. Great while it lasted. But it broke within a year. I play at pretty high apm. And it was accurate enough that I could control all my units well. I just wanted a good mouse at a decent price. But it was not. So users recommended me to get a Zowie. Seems good quality enough. But it just feels large, bulky, heavy.
reviews.author: Skillet

reviews.title: Its pricy, but it is the best
reviews.comment: I have never had connection issues, I love the dock. Its exactly what I wanted it to be.
reviews.author: Adam

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: Wow I love this mouse. I came from GPX and felt like I needed something that fit me better. GPX is a literal brick block with a sensor. I have sub 18cm hands so this S2-DW allowed me to really get a grip. The structure is just perfect. Better thumb groove and pinkie.
reviews.author: Jonathan
